header.name: Maya Chen
header.headline: Pricing and revenue strategy · B2B distribution

profile: Pricing lead with six years in B2B distribution, turning messy transaction data into list-price and discount decisions that sales teams actually adopt. Recovered **2.1 pts of gross margin** at Fabrikam by closing discount leakage across 3 APAC markets.

experience.title: Pricing Lead, APAC
experience.summary: Owns pricing for a S$310M catalogue across 3 markets; team of 4.
bullets: Recovered **2.1 pts gross margin (S$6.5M a year)** by closing discount leakage, by mapping 1.2M invoice lines to approval rules and redesigning deal-desk thresholds

bullets.text: Lifted price-change adoption from 40% to 85% of SKUs within two quarters, by
sub: co-designing a monthly pricing review with 3 country sales heads
replacing spreadsheet uploads with a validated Power BI workflow

bullets: Cut quote turnaround from 3 days to same-day for 70% of deals by automating standard-discount approvals

experience.title: Commercial Analyst
bullets: Built the first price-volume-mix bridge for the regional P&L, adopted in monthly CFO reviews
Identified S$1.2M in under-priced long-tail SKUs; 60% repriced within 6 months

items: Certified Pricing Professional (CPP), Professional Pricing Society, 2022
